title: Ko Slumber Duuɓi
intro: Aɗa jogori waɗde yahdu e nder jamaanu, aɗa hawra e sirlu luggiɗiiɗo e goonɗinal e doole Alla. Miijo-ɗee fedde yimɓe ƴaañiiɓe e nder renndo mum en, jokkondirɓe e diineeji gooti e nder aduna diineeji keewɗi. Daarol mabbe ko seedantaagal Alla mbaawka reende maccuɓe mum moƴƴuɓe e laabi ɓurɗi haawnaade. Mbele aɗa waawi ƴeewtaade sifaa ɗeen limooje kaawniiɗe ?
clues: Minen ko min fedde tokosere sagataaɓe gooŋɗinɓe Geno gooto, hay so tawii noon Shirki ina yaaji e nder leñol amen.
En ndogi laamɗo jom doole en, hulɓiniiɗo en ngam iimanaagal men, en kuli tooñanngeeji e maayde.
En ɗaɓɓitii reentaade e nokku keeriiɗo, eɗen ɗaminii yurmeende Alla e ndeenka men e tooñooɓe men.
Joomiraacfo men wacfi en 6ooyde e 6ooygol, 6ooyngol kaawis ngol 6ooyngol yahdu jamaanu.
Nde min njippii, min cikkatnoo ko min pooftii tan ko ñalawma gooto walla feccere ñalawma, min nganndaa dumunna jaajɗo mo min njahdi e goonga.
Quraana siftinii wonde en ngoni ko e ngonka men duuɓi teemedde tati, en njaltii heen duuɓi jeenay, wonti maande wonande ɓiɓɓe aadama.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ɓe ndokkaama jawdi e doole keewɗe
Ɓe mbayliima wonti ɓowɗi e baali
Ɓe ummitinaama e ɗanngal ko maande luggiɗnde
outcome.answer: Ɓe ummitinaama e ɗanngal ko maande luggiɗnde

verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (Al-Kahf 18:25)
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
